revision.description: Settings revision, incremented by every write; a change against an older revision is refused with conflict.

model_slots.description: Machine cap of concurrently running workers (job kind llm), warm or fresh, across all projects and the machine scope (Machine Lease Stores, model-slots.json); a warm worker holds its slot for its whole generation, idle or not; per plan at most one of them is a writer worker.

drain_timeout_seconds.description: How long running jobs may finish after SIGTERM/SIGINT, pm-operator drain, or the operator's stop with when drain, before their process groups are terminated and recorded killed (runtime-model.adoc, Drain, Stop & Upgrade; timeouts.adoc, Runtime Lifecycle); a stop with when now cuts it to zero. The runtime's drain reads an invalid value (negative, not an integer, or a file that is unreadable or not one JSON object) as the default, with a warning, and never fails for it.

escalation_cap_seconds.description: Cap C of the one-shot escalation budget E = max(t, min(2t, C)) after a timed_out job (timeouts.adoc, Job Budgets).

progress_wait_max_seconds.description: Upper bound of a progress wait (timeouts.adoc, Waits & Long-Polls).

audit_rotation.description: Rotation thresholds of logs/audit.jsonl (checkpoint record, audit-index.jsonl entry); whichever is reached first rotates

retain_days.description: Age in days after which a rotated audit file is technical residue the periodic sweep removes (Evidence-Based Removal Sweeps); 0 keeps rotated files forever. Index entries are never removed.

harness_profiles.description: Machine-wide operator overrides of a harness profile's connection settings; no other profile key can be overridden. An override passes the same profile validation as the compiled value (for a harness whose progress_resets_timeout is false, bounded_wait_seconds at most idle_timeout_seconds - 30; timeouts.adoc, Harness Integration).

propertyNames.description: harness_id of a profile of the effective profile set, an operator-added one included (identifiers.adoc, harness_id).

connection.description: Each present key replaces the profile's compiled value; an absent key keeps it.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Harness tool-call idle timeout (timeouts.adoc, Harness Integration).

progress_resets_timeout.description: Whether notifications/progress resets the harness's tool-call timer.

proxy.description: Optional outbound proxy, applied to every cui-http call (provider calls, the icon fetch, the release check and fetch) and to the JGit transport of the native git variant; never taken from a repository value or from the environment. Absent: direct connections.

https_proxy.description: Proxy URL (scheme, host, optional port) without embedded credentials; a URL with user information is refused. Authenticated proxies are not supported (later-improvements.adoc, L-8).

no_proxy.description: Hosts reached directly, without the proxy.

web.description: Web access of the runtime with its two listeners side by side (PM-SEC-7; CLI, Coordination & Security Specification, Loopback and LAN Listeners Side by Side). Absent: both closed. The runtime opens each listener at every start while its switch is true.

enabled.description: The loopback listener: plain HTTP on 127.0.0.1 at port. Written true by pm-operator web enable (also by a first pm-operator web pair, web open, or the terminal client's entry) and false by pm-operator web disable, which also writes lan false; paired devices survive false.

lan.description: The LAN listener: HTTPS on all interfaces at lan_port with the certificate in <PM_MCP_BASE>/web/tls/, beside the loopback listener. Written true by pm-operator web enable --lan or the entry's yes to other devices (both also write enabled true); written false by pm-operator web disable and by turning the network listener off from either client, which leaves enabled unchanged.

port.description: TCP port of the loopback listener, used the next time it opens (an open listener is never re-bound).

lan_port.description: TCP port of the LAN listener, used the next time it opens; never equal to port. Each listener applies the occupied-port rule to its own port: an occupied port fails the verb that opens it and leaves that switch unchanged; at a runtime start it leaves that listener closed, reported in the runtime status, while the runtime and the other listener still start. Another port is never chosen.

language.description: The two languages of Module Structure, Languages and Internationalisation.

interface.description: The operator's interface language: a locale with a language pack. Absent: the locale of the client's request where a pack exists, else en; the runtime's own environment is never an input. A machine fact, with no project value.

model.description: The machine's model language: same (the interface language) or a locale; a project's language.model of local-config.json overrides it.

format.description: The form of a diagram in text a model writes for a human (the writing skill): text, a fixed-width text diagram, or mermaid, a fenced Mermaid block; a project's diagrams.format of local-config.json overrides it.

default.description: harness_id of a worker-eligible harness of harnesses.json, written by harness.enrol of the onboarding and its later runs; the steward runs on it. A harness that is the default cannot be removed before another is chosen.

store.description: The credential store the operator chose in the onboarding's store step or its verb (CLI, Coordination & Security Specification, Credential Store as an Operator Choice); no default: before it is recorded no credential can be entered. The runtime uses the recorded store and never another.

providers.description: The machine's provider defaults (Machine Provider Defaults).

available.description: true only once its verification passed, or false on the operator's word after a failed verification; a provider recorded false never serves a project.

variant.description: The default integration variant of a project that sets none; cli only for git, github, and gitlab.

credential_key.description: The credential entry the provider uses where a project names none (identifiers.adoc, credential_key).

plan_defaults.description: The machine's variant of each plan behaviour axis (Workflow DSL Specification, Plan Behaviour Axes); a project's team or operator value and a plan's own override it; posture is no axis but resolves by the same levels.

posture.description: Optional, no default: the machine's execution posture, set in the machine's settings and never asked in the onboarding; while neither the machine nor the project sets it, a plan asks it in init.options (Workflow DSL Specification, Posture and base branch).

documents_mode.description: How the documents of a start are taken into its source directory (State Catalogue Specification, Documents as a Source); answering always in the start writes copy or move here.

cleanup.description: Durations of the one cleanup (Timeouts & Budgets Specification, One Cleanup): an item is due when its end is older than its duration; a project's local-config.json cleanup overrides the first three for its items.

unenrolled_after_days.description: Machine stores of unenrolled projects; machine only.

remind_after_days.description: After how many days a postponed cleanup asks again.

notify.description: Whether the terminal client signals a new report or decision.

full_screen.description: Whether the terminal client opens in its full-screen view.

project_defaults.description: The machine's value of the per-project operator keys; each local-config.json key of $defs/settings falls back to this value, then to the compiled default (Operator Local Configuration).

cleanup_duration.description: Days, at least 7 so that no window of the system view (at most 7 days) loses data, or never.
